color.note: Cool, slightly violet neutrals plus one violet. Light is the first theme; dark swaps every token. Violet marks selection and the primary signal; the violet-to-magenta gradient is the brand moment, used only on active indicators and the logo.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Window ground behind content: Task view, Start menu footer, Settings canvas. `ink` and `muted` read on it.

tokens.name: desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop ground under the windows, with the 24px `desktop-dot` grid. Also inactive title bars and window thumbnails.

tokens.name: desktop-dot
tokens.usage: The 1px dots of the desktop grid, every 24px. Decoration only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Windows, the taskbar, menus, flyouts and setting cards: anything above `page` or `desktop`. `ink`, `muted` and `accent` text all pass on it.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Resting fill of the search pill, address bars, steppers' track and the segmented control. `ink` and `muted` text pass; no `accent` text on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: window edges, taskbar top edge, row dividers. Decoration, never the only signal.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover and selected fill for taskbar buttons, menu rows and nav items. `ink` text passes on it.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Letter tiles and placeholder blocks, with `chip-ink` on top.

tokens.name: chip-ink
tokens.usage: Text or glyph on `chip`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, switch track when on, primary button fill, focus ring. 14:1 or more on every ground above.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, timestamps, cell ids, shortcut hints. 4.5:1 or more on `page`, `surface` and `field` in both themes.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Disabled icons, the switch track when off, dashed grid outlines. A state, never body text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one violet: selected nav pill, snap target outline, links, the hovered snap zone. Text only on `page` and `surface`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover and pressed accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Fill inside the snap target preview, behind the `accent` 2px outline.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text or icon on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: Second brand hue from the logo. End stop of the active-indicator gradient (`accent` to `magenta`). Never text.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Third brand hue, from the logo's E. Brand graphics and the Software app tile only; not a UI colour.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed state text and its check, always with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Close-button hover fill (with white glyph), destructive actions, error text on `danger-bg`.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind an error message or a destructive confirmation.

tokens.name: terminal
tokens.usage: Terminal window body. Text on it is `terminal-ink`; prompts in `terminal-muted`.

tokens.name: terminal-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `terminal`.

tokens.name: terminal-muted
tokens.usage: Prompts and labels on `terminal`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding and lock-screen titles. One per screen.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Section titles in menus and panels.

styles.name: group
styles.usage: Group labels above setting cards and Start menu sections.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Setting titles, menu items, button labels.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Descriptions under a setting title, file names in lists.
styles.sample: Also used as the margin at screen edges

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Window titles, app names under tiles, the taskbar clock.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Grid cell ids (A1:B2), keyboard shortcuts, paths and config values shown verbatim.

spacing.note: 4px base. The grid gap (`space-3`) is also the screen-edge margin, so windows and gaps line up on every screen.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between taskbar buttons; between stacked setting cards.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in small controls; taskbar side padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: THE GRID GAP: between snapped windows and at screen edges. Default `[grid] gap`.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and flyout inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Start menu side padding; between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections; Settings content padding.

radius.note: Rounded, but tighter than a phone: windows are 8px like a desktop OS. Larger floating surfaces get larger radii.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Snap-layout zones, cell buttons in the cell picker.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: List rows inside windows, small fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Windows, setting cards, address bars, task view thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Taskbar buttons, Start menu app cells, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The Start menu panel.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Flyouts: snap layouts, quick settings, calendar.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon tiles: always a quarter of the tile size (16 on a 64 tile).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Search pill, switches, the active indicator.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The only shadow: the focused window, a window being dragged, the Start menu and flyouts. Docked parts use a `line` hairline instead.
